pulumi/pulumi-java.language-test-path: pkg/cmd/pulumi-language-java/language_test.go (expectedFailures map near the bottom of the file, after TestLanguage)
pulumi/pulumi-java.pinned-dep: Two halves, usually two commits on the renovate branch: (1) the `pulumi` git submodule + .gitmodules, (2) `github.com/pulumi/pulumi/{pkg,sdk}/v3` in the root `go.mod`/`go.sum`. There is ONE Go module, rooted at the repo root — there is no pkg/go.mod or tests/go.mod, and `sdk/go.mod` is a `module phony` stub that only keeps sdk/ out of `go mod download`. Run `mise exec -- make tidy` after touching go.mod.
pulumi/pulumi-java.test-cmd: cd pkg && go test ./cmd/pulumi-language-java/ -run 'TestLanguage/<test-name>' -count 1  (full suite: `mise exec -- make test_go`)
pulumi/pulumi-java.codegen-tests: mise exec -- make codegen_tests ; accept with `mise exec -- make codegen_tests_update` (PULUMI_ACCEPT=true under pkg/codegen/java)
pulumi/pulumi-java.ci-jobs: ci.yml jobs: prerequisites, java-sdk-tests, go-tests (runs `cd pkg && go test -timeout 40m ./...` — this is the conformance job), examples, go-lint, ci-ok. `examples` needs cloud creds and is skipped on forks.
pulumi/pulumi-java.changelog-cmd: mise exec -- make changelog (changie). Dependency bumps are usually `impact/no-changelog-required`.
pulumi/pulumi-java.gotchas: Conformance tests need the core SDK published to Maven Local at version 0.0.1: `cd sdk/java && mise exec -- gradle publishToMavenLocal` with PULUMI_JAVA_SDK_VERSION=0.0.1. After editing sdk/java, delete ~/.m2/repository/com/pulumi/pulumi/0.0.1 before re-running, or you test a stale SDK. Kill stray java/gradle processes before a run. Tests are t.Parallel and slow — run one test at a time while diagnosing, not the whole suite.

pulumi/pulumi-yaml.pinned-dep: github.com/pulumi/pulumi/{pkg,sdk}/v3 in the root go.mod — single Go module, no git submodule (dropped in #1143). Run `go mod tidy` after touching go.mod; move ./tmp aside first or tidy pollutes go.mod with indirect→direct promotions.
pulumi/pulumi-yaml.codegen-tests: PULUMI_ACCEPT=true go test --run=TestGenerateExamples ./pkg/tests — then review diffs in pkg/tests/transpiled_examples/ (golden files, never hand-edit)
pulumi/pulumi-yaml.ci-jobs: pr-tests.yaml dispatches stage-lint.yml (Lint) and stage-test.yml (Test, matrix over go/python/dotnet/node). Schema-loading failures after a dep bump usually mean `make get_schemas`.
pulumi/pulumi-yaml.changelog-cmd: changie new (components: codegen, docs, runtime, convert). Dependency bumps are usually impact/no-changelog-required.
pulumi/pulumi-yaml.gotchas: utils.NewContext's built-in provider list gets trimmed upstream between releases — 'could not locate a compatible plugin' in codegen/example tests means switch to utils.NewContextWithProviders with the schemas from scripts/get_schemas.sh. Schema JSON in pkg/pulumiyaml/testing/test/testdata/ is downloaded, never hand-edited. Don't run the full integration suite locally; CI does.

pulumi/pulumi-hcl.pinned-dep: github.com/pulumi/pulumi/{pkg,sdk}/v3 in the root go.mod — single Go module, no git submodule. Run `make tidy` after touching go.mod.
pulumi/pulumi-hcl.codegen-tests: none separate — conformance snapshots under cmd/pulumi-language-hcl/testdata/ are the golden files
pulumi/pulumi-hcl.ci-jobs: ci.yml jobs: lint, test, codecov-notify, build-sdk, vendored-drift
pulumi/pulumi-hcl.changelog-cmd: changie new (dependency bumps are usually impact/no-changelog-required)
pulumi/pulumi-hcl.gotchas: Tests added to expectedFailures must have their testdata/{projects,round-tripped-project,eject-pcl}/<test-name> dirs git rm'd (shared sdks/ stay). PULUMI_ACCEPT still runs full validation — a passing accept run is real validation. The pulumi CLI on PATH is a real dependency for conformance runs.

pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.pinned-dep: Three places pin pulumi/pulumi, all must match: (1) the `pulumi` git submodule + .gitmodules branch field, (2) github.com/pulumi/pulumi/{pkg,sdk}/v3 in pulumi-language-dotnet/go.mod, (3) same in integration_tests/go.mod. Run `go mod tidy` in each dir touched.
pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.test-cmd: mise exec -- make test_conformance TEST_FILTER=<test-name> — ONE test per invocation: the Makefile interpolates TEST_FILTER unquoted, so a regex with | breaks the shell line
pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.accept-cmd: PULUMI_ACCEPT=1 mise exec -- make test_conformance TEST_FILTER=<test-name>
pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.codegen-tests: mise exec -- make test_codegen ; golden files in pulumi-language-dotnet/codegen/testdata/, accept with PULUMI_ACCEPT=1 make test_codegen
pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.ci-jobs: pr.yml (name: Build and test) jobs: setup_matrix, format, lint, lint-changelog, build, integration-tests, conformance-tests, codegen-tests, info, release-dev-sdk, check-pr
pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.changelog-cmd: make changelog (changie). Dependency bumps are usually impact/no-changelog-required.
pulumi/pulumi-dotnet.gotchas: All make test_* targets depend on `build` (full SDK + language host) — first run is slow. TEST_FILTER wires into gotestsum. Run `mise install` first to get pinned tool versions. The `build` CI job runs `make test_automation_codegen` then a 'Workspace clean' check: if the upgrade changes CLI help text, run `mise exec -- make generate_automation_api` (spec comes from the submodule, no external CLI needed) then `make build_sdk`, and commit sdk/Pulumi.Automation/Commands/Options.cs + Pulumi.Automation.xml. The repo merges through the GitHub merge queue: `gh pr merge --squash --auto`, then the queue's own CI run takes ~30 min after checks go green — poll PR state, don't assume merged.
